html:
SMTO-PRX-0001 — Proxmox can't do that power action for this kind of machine

GUID: 818b9b25-9f60-461c-9e8b-19032f659179
Slug: proxmox-action-unsupported
Domain: PRX · Subsystem: prx

What happened

  • Proxmox supports different power actions for virtual machines and containers. The action you asked for isn't available for this one, so nothing was sent to Proxmox.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Check whether the machine is a virtual machine or a container. You can ask SMTO, or look in the Proxmox web interface. Containers can't be reset; they support start, stop, shut down, reboot, suspend and resume.
  2. Ask SMTO to use a supported action instead, for example reboot rather than reset for a container. A reboot restarts a container in the way Proxmox allows.
  3. Make sure you named the right machine. A machine with a similar name may be a different type that supports different actions.

What success looks like

  • SMTO reports the action finished and shows the machine in the state you expected.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages your Proxmox server or SMTO. Don't treat this message as the action having happened; nothing was sent to Proxmox.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • Proxmox power planning found no advertised status POST endpoint for this guest type and action (for example reset on an LXC container), so nothing was dispatched.

What this means

  • Power planning constructs the selected guest-type action endpoint and finds no matching advertised POST endpoint specification. Proxmox task and resource receipts own effect truth. A failed read, expired local wait or invalid response does not undo a mutation; diagnostics never replay writes or escalate graceful shutdown to forced stop.

Why this can happen

  • Power planning constructs the selected guest-type action endpoint and finds no matching advertised POST endpoint specification.

How to diagnose it

  • Compare the guest type and action with currently advertised endpoint operations.

How to fix it

  • Use an action the pinned Proxmox API advertises for the guest type: QEMU virtual machines support start, stop, shutdown, reboot, reset, suspend and resume; LXC containers support the same except reset. Confirm the guest type from the guest list before choosing.
  • Choose an operation advertised by the Proxmox skill.

Retry and execution caution

  • Apply the correction and confirm the relevant state before requesting another attempt. Prior completed work remains governed by its receipts.

How to verify the fix

  • A supported action is selected for the exact intended guest.

What not to do

  • Do not bypass the unsupported-feature check or reinterpret an unsupported response as success.

Technical notes

  • Proxmox task and resource receipts own effect truth. A failed read, expired local wait or invalid response does not undo a mutation; diagnostics never replay writes or escalate graceful shutdown to forced stop.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
